onboarding.title: Set up your household
onboarding.description: Alfheim apps share data within a household. Create a new one or join an existing household with an invite code or QR code.
onboarding.create_desc: Start fresh and invite family members or flatmates afterwards.
onboarding.join_desc: Paste the invite code you received, or scan the invite QR code with your phone's camera to open the join link directly.

join.title: Join a household
join.description: Redeem an invite code to become a member.
join.missing_token: No invite code in this link. Enter the code manually.

invites.title: Active invites
invites.confirm_revoke: Revoke this invite? The code and QR code stop working immediately.

settings.title: Household settings
settings.default_desc: Apps open this household first after you sign in.
settings.transfer_desc: Hand the owner role to another member. You become an admin.
settings.confirm_transfer: Transfer ownership to {name}? You will no longer be the owner.
settings.no_transfer_candidates: Invite another member first to transfer ownership.
settings.leave_desc: You lose access to this household's data in all apps.
settings.leave_owner_hint: Owners must transfer ownership before leaving.
settings.delete_desc: Permanently deletes the household, its members, invites and contacts.

delete_modal.title: Delete "{name}"?
delete_modal.description: This cannot be undone. Type the household name to confirm.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this household.
errors.household_not_found: This household doesn't exist or you are no longer a member.
errors.invite_not_found: This invite code is invalid, expired or has been revoked.
errors.conflict: This conflicts with the current state. {detail}
